k: İngilizce Tercüme - Uluslararası Nur Merkezi (sürüm 1.1.2) — QuranEnc.com kaynağından değiştirilmeden; şartlar: https://quranenc.com/tr/home/api/
t: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
From the evil of the retreating whisperer[2016] -
Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
From among the jinn and mankind."[2017]
dn: [2016] i.e., a devil who makes evil suggestions to man but disappears when one remembers Allāh.
[2017] Evil prompters may be from men as well as from jinn.
